name: @la/engine
description: The language-blind turn-loop engine (issue #9): generate → verify → anglicize, built to the candidates(1..N) → cheap-rank → gate-the-winner shape (ADR §1.5, N=1 in the walking skeleton); the tutor-message wire-schema builder (architecture.md §3); the injected CandidateGenerator boundary; and the reusable seam-4/5 walking-skeleton stand-ins (FixedRatioScaffold, SeedVocabBypassCurriculum) a pack's own manifest configures. Depends ONLY on @la/contract + zod at runtime — never a lang-* package (ADR §2.4 rule a).
